title: feat(cli): os migrate blank-single-values cleans the '' stored on optional single-value columns (#29346 ruling B, seat ruling 6588116815)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8XaSQxAaAAj12QNAdTf4gAY)_
Fixes #29431

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增 `os migrate blank-single-values`,把旧行里存着 `''` 的可选单值选项、引用、文件列一次性改写为 `null`。
- 为什么改:#29277 之后写入口把清空存为 `null`,但旧行仍是 `''`,`$empty: true` 找不到它们(#29346 裁决 B,席位裁决走独立命令)。
- 风险与回滚:默认只读演练;`--apply` 才改写,且只动 `''`、不碰必填/多值/文本列;回滚即撤 PR,已改写的 `null` 与新写入同形。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.ts` 的 `blankSingleValueColumns` 与 `cleanBlankSingleValues`;再看其 sqlite 集成测试。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.integration.test.ts`,应见 5/5 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **New command `os migrate blank-single-values`** (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.ts`), the one-time data step that ruling B on #29346 (record 6579813296) binds: "stored `''` on those columns is cleaned once by an `os migrate` data step". The server seat's ruling on this card (record 6588116815, route B) puts it in a sibling command modelled on `summary-nulls`, not in `value-shapes`, whose documented contract is that it rewrites nothing and records only its flag (needs_decision report 6588090153).
- **Columns** come from `blankAsNullColumns` (`@objectstack/core`), the rule the write door and the seed replay read. The map holds three arms; the command keeps reach `empty` minus the spec's `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` (the #29176 unique-text arm), which leaves the optional single-value columns on the `$empty` table's `null_only` row: `select`, `radio`, `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`, `tree`, `image`, `file`, `avatar`, `video`, `audio` (seat 3's amendment 6584231754). No type name is listed in the command. `required`, `multiple: true`, text-like and typed columns are out by the map's own rule.
- **Shape, as `summary-nulls`:** dry run by default (read-only boot, counts per object and column, writes no row); `--apply` rewrites each affected row's `''` columns to `null` in one engine update under the system context; `--yes` / `--json` confirmation rules; SQLite occupancy gate with `--force`; `--object` narrows and refuses an undeclared name; `--max-records`; no deployment flag; idempotent, so a re-run that reports zero is the verification. The value is tested in JS (`=== ''`), never pushed down as a filter.
- **Roster rows** for the new command in the three suites that enumerate `os migrate` commands from disk: `schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration.test.ts`, `migrate-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts`, `json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts`.
- **Docs:** a table row and a section in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`. **Changeset:** `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Why

Rows cleared before #29277 still store `''` on these columns, and the `$empty` table reads `''` as a value there, so `$empty: true` misses them and `$empty: false` finds them. Measured on `origin/main` 50e35a28 before this change: `packages/rest/src/rest-data-single-value-blank.test.ts` case "the $empty table is unchanged" plants such a row through knex and pins that `$empty: true` does not return it (1 passed). The new test's first case reproduces the same miss on all eleven types.

## Tests

`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.integration.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` + sqlite `SqlDriver`; legacy rows written through the driver, below the door; physical column read with the driver's knex):

- the column set is exactly the eleven types (no `required`, text, unique text, `multiple: true`);
- red before: `$empty: true` misses the stored `''` on every in-scope column;
- a dry run counts 1 per column (12 values over two objects) and leaves the physical row byte-identical;
- `--apply`: every in-scope column is physically `NULL` and `$empty: true` finds the row; the `required` select and the text columns still hold `''`, the multi-value column is unchanged; a re-run reads zero;
- `objects` narrows the walk.

<details><summary>Test readings (head b3c282c9)</summary>

- New test: `vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/blank-single-values.integration.test.ts` → Tests 5 passed (5).
- Ablation, one run: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `engine.update(...)` call (anchor 1 → 0, blob b2125f18 → 5e11e3db); the `--apply` case went red (Tests 1 failed, 4 passed); restored to blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the command from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` → exit 0 (tsc + `check:test-typecheck` OK).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` → 372/374 files, 5246 tests passed; the 2 failing files were `published-subpath-console.pin` and `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`, both refusing because `packages/cli` was not built. After the build: those two, `migrate-confirmation-exit.pin`, `schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration`, `vitest-tiers-partition` and the new test → 6 files, 237 tests passed.
- `json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts` is a nightly-tier file (by name), not run locally.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card title says "an `os migrate value-shapes` step"; this PR ships `os migrate blank-single-values` per seat ruling 6588116815, inside #29346's binding text.
- The write goes through `engine.update` with the system context, as `summary-nulls` does, so hooks and `updated_at` run as for any system write.
